gloss: on the strong side; slightly dark/rich

definitions.gloss: on the strong/dark/rich side; somewhat concentrated
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is slightly stronger, darker, or richer than standard — typically flavor, color, or makeup. The suffix {目|め} indicates 'leaning toward' or 'on the ... side.'

examples.japanese: コーヒーは{濃|こ}い{目|め}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like my coffee on the strong side.

examples.japanese: {味付|あじつ}けを{濃|こ}い{目|め}にしてください。
examples.english: Please make the seasoning a bit stronger.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{濃|こ}い{目|め}のメイクで{出|で}かけることにした。
examples.english: I decided to go out with slightly heavier makeup today.

notes: Uses the suffix {目|め} attached to adjective stems to mean 'somewhat' or 'on the ... side.' The pattern Adj-stem + {目|め} is productive: {薄|うす}め (on the light/thin side), {甘|あま}め (on the sweet side), {大|おお}きめ (on the large side). Written with kanji as {濃|こ}い{目|め} or in kana as こいめ. Commonly used when ordering food or drinks to specify preference. Opposite: {薄|うす}め (on the weak/light side).
